newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish firms Jan-July net profit just down vs 1995.
newsitem.headline: Polish firms Jan-July net profit just down vs 1995.

text.p: Polish enterprises reported an overall 5.6 billion zloty net profit in the January-July period, compared with a 5.8 billion zloty net profit in the same period of 1995, the Central Statistical Office (GUS) said.

GUS said the private sector had a net profit of 3.1 billion zlotys on total revenues of 141.7 billion in the period against a profit of 1.8 billion and sales of 92.8 billion in the same period last year.
The state-owned sector reported a profit of 2.5 billion on sales of 149.8 billion versus last year's 4.0 billion and 130.5 billion respectively.
NOTES: Data collected from all companies employing more than 50 people in main sectors of the economy.
Liquidity ratio is a percentage relation of cash reserves and tradable securities to short-term liabilities.
